summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and then uses that runtime via `execFileSync` to execute `math_init.js`, a 727KB heavily obfuscated bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` uses a shuffled string/number constant array (`n7gIxM`), an array-rotator (`WV8StW`), and a decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — classic string-array obfuscation that hides the payload's actual behavior. The package is presented as a React marketing UI component library, a purpose that has no need for a second JavaScript runtime at install time or for an obfuscated bundle with a misleading `math_init` filename. Because installation fetches a second runtime specifically to execute an opaque, author-controlled binary blob on every `npm install`, the true behavior of the executed code cannot be verified and can be changed silently in any future publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
